candidates.title: Why frontier AI labs may capture most new compute — and why the economics can work
candidates.executiveSummary: Dylan Patel argues that OpenAI and Anthropic are absorbing a rapidly rising share of new AI compute because frontier labs can monetize compute more aggressively than traditional buyers. The key idea is value amplification across the AI stack: expensive compute can still be rational when downstream model and application value is much larger.
candidates.whyItMatters: This reframes AI infrastructure from a cost-center story into a value-capture story. It helps explain why frontier labs can keep bidding up compute and why infrastructure concentration may continue.
candidates.taiwanImpact: Taiwan should look beyond chip shipment volume toward where value is captured in systems, networking, power, cloud operations and AI services.
candidates.hpeLens: The opportunity is not only servers: AI factories require networking, systems integration, observability, power/cooling and enterprise deployment architecture.
candidates.investmentLens: Watch who can convert compute into revenue fastest; compute ownership alone is less important than downstream value capture.
keyNumbers: OpenAI + Anthropic roughly 30% of new compute now
historical frontier-lab allocation roughly 60% training/research vs 40% inference

candidates.title: Jensen Huang: open models matter strategically to NVIDIA
candidates.executiveSummary: Jensen Huang explains why NVIDIA wants a much larger role in open-model AI: open models broaden developer adoption, reduce dependence on closed labs, and expand the workloads that ultimately consume NVIDIA infrastructure.
candidates.whyItMatters: NVIDIA is signaling that its long-term moat is broader than GPUs. It wants influence over the developer and model ecosystem that drives future infrastructure demand.
candidates.taiwanImpact: A broader open-model ecosystem can expand AI infrastructure demand across Taiwan ODMs, networking, storage and data-center supply chains.
candidates.hpeLens: Open-model adoption increases demand for enterprise-grade AI infrastructure, hybrid deployment, networking and lifecycle operations — areas where HPE can compete above the silicon layer.
candidates.investmentLens: NVIDIA is extending vertically into ecosystem control while still preserving demand for its core infrastructure platform.
